premarket.market_expectations: Markets are positioned for a bullish opening with strong overnight gains in US indices and favorable domestic institutional flows. The rupee's strength against the dollar and stable bond yields provide support, though elevated oil prices and top-third valuation positioning may cap upside. Defense and FMCG sectors show relative strength, while geopolitical tensions and global tech sector concerns remain watchpoints. Trading bias leans long with normal conviction levels.
